assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
To accurately characterize the frequency and burden of these arrhythmic events and guide subsequent rate or rhythm control management
a 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study is indicated
This 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary to address the diagnosed arrhythmias and inform appropriate management
